summary.text: Cory Criswell is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 54, assumed office on November 9, 2022, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Nan Polk (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Cory Criswell was born in New Castle, Indiana, earned a bachelor's degree in physical education teaching and coaching from Anderson University, and earned a master's degree in education administration from Ball State University in 2020.

His career experience includes owning Criswell Lawn Care and working as an assistant varsity boys basketball coach, and he has been affiliated with the Indiana Farm Bureau and the National Rifle Association.
Criswell succeeded Thomas Saunders (R) in District 54.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture and Rural Development, House Public Policy, and Ways and Means committees.
